en-GB.name: Need A Cab Plus
en-GB.summary: Request a cash taxi as a guest.
en-GB.description: Private preview. Confirm your pickup from the device address or shared current location, choose a destination and hear the Autocab cash fare before confirming. No taxi is sent in test mode.
examplePhrases: Alexa, open need a cab plus
Alexa, ask need a cab plus to book a taxi to the train station
